tool_updates.description: Kennametal TopSwiss CCGT positive FFS fine-finishing insert geometry, ANSI CCGT21505MFFS / ISO CCGT060202MFFS, 6.35 mm IC, 2.38 mm thickness, 2.8 mm fixing hole, and 0.2 mm corner radius. Reviewed current manufacturer variant material 7154831 uses grade KCS25S; legacy grade claims remain preserved as separate grade options.
